intro: I'm Rami, a DevOps engineer in Cairo and a Communications Engineering student at Ain Shams University, studying a DevOps diploma at Rowad Masr alongside my degree. I like taking software that only runs on one machine and making it build, test and ship itself: containers, CI/CD pipelines and small, reliable infrastructure. Outside DevOps I coach, play chess, train and speak, and make short videos.
now: A team DevOps and Cloud project: a web app we're containerizing and shipping with a full CI/CD pipeline
Learning Kubernetes and Helm, Terraform, AWS fundamentals, and Prometheus with Grafana
